technical_requirements_summary:
- workload: chat/support, low concurrency, bursty traffic
- latency target: <300ms 95th perc for typical support queries
- throughput: ~200 reqs/day initially, scale to 2k/day
- model preference: small-medium open models for cost, ability to route to cheaper variants on burst
- routing/fallback: prefer single-region serving (us-east), auto-fallback to smaller model when cost spike
- data handling: opt-out logging per workspace, per-conversation deletion, prompt redaction before storage, retention TTL configurable
detailed_privacy_questions: 1) How long are raw prompts stored by default? 2) Can prompts be excluded from logs or hashed server-side? 3) Is there a deletion API and SLA for purge? 4) Can retention be set per account/workspace? 5) How do you handle EU data residency for EU merchants? 6) What is the audit trail when data is deleted?
